"Jeet ho ya na ho, tu learning kar raha."
"Action bina motivation—bas baat."
Learning ka passion banao.
Time limited hai—dusre ki life jeeke waste mat karo.
"Motivation ghati, standards bache."
"Itne good bano, log ignore na kar sake."
Chahe aap sochein ki aap kar sakte hain, ya sochein ki aap nahi kar sakte - aap sahi hain.
Quality ek act nahi, habit hai.
Abhi start, future ko tumhari zarurat.
"Thoughts words ban jaate."
Confidence contagious hota hai.
Disappointment wisdom ka nurse hai.
